head_commit.message:
docs: explain JavaScript and TypeScript client usage

Describe CallbackClient and AsyncClient in the shared package, including the
Client compatibility alias, generated JavaScript and declarations. Show a
Promise request beside the callback examples and scope their setup advice.

Document locked JavaScript release dependencies, version-lock consistency
and the installed-artifact runtime and declaration checks so maintainers can
verify both interfaces before publication.
